title: Comparative Assessments of Similar Medical Procedures across Countries to Understand Cost Variations
what_it_is: Comparative Assessments of Similar Medical Procedures across Countries to Understand Cost Variations

sections.label: Comparing medical procedure costs across jurisdictions
sections.summary: Comparing individual medical procedure costs across jurisdictions is generally not advisable, and healthcare costs must be moderated through a holistic approach.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Generally, it is not advisable to compare individual medical procedure costs across jurisdictions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Quality, labour market conditions, model of care and protocols can be different.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Ultimately, we have to moderate healthcare costs through a holistic approach, including value-based care, developing fee benchmarks, instil discipline in insurance, rely on cost effective treatment and focusing on preventive care and population health.
